text:
santiago: FYI support flagged a p99 spike for a eu-west customer (C-2123). p95 ~1.8s -> p99 ~6.2s since 04:12 UTC. Suspect host/kernel/driver I/O noise after kernel+GPU driver update pushed at 03:47 UTC.
emma: on it. can you paste affected hosts + minimal repro so eng can reproduce?
santiago: affected hosts: eu-west-gpu-03, eu-west-gpu-04; customer calls show large tail on token generation. Snippet from node metrics:
```
node: eu-west-gpu-03
cpu_idle 92%
nvme_io_wait 27ms -> 200ms
kernel_ioq_depth 128 -> 512
```
dmesg shows repeated "nvme timeout" lines.
liam: i saw deploy-bot rolled driver 535.54 -> 535.78 to eu-west at 03:47. rolling across 6 hosts. tagging infra-oncall.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: driver-update-eu-west rolled to eu-west-gpu-01..06 at 03:47 UTC (ci/driver-release-535.78). :information_source:
kamal: customer repro: one-shot request to /v1/generate (200 tokens) reproducibly hits p99 ~6s. curl with --write-out timings:
```
$ curl -s -o /dev/null -w "time_total:%{time_total}\n" -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{...}'
# typical good: time_total:0.9
# spike: time_total:6.1
```
jordan: can we quick mitigate by routing their traffic to eu-north or fallback model (smaller model)? we have routing policies per-customer.
emma: agree. liaise with support to route customer; also start draining eu-west-gpu-03/04 from serving pool and put them on rollback path.
liam: i'm reproing now in a repro lab by switching driver to 535.78 on an isolated node. simple test harness (loadgen) shows 95th 200ms -> 1.5s p99 after nvme qdepth increases. posting command:
```
# reproduce
ssh node
sudo apt install driver-535.78
run ./loadgen --seq-len 512 --concurrency 8
```
santiago: ok liam, proceed with rollback on eu-west-gpu-03/04, put nodes in maintenance, and route customer to eu-north. support to confirm customer routing.
liam: rollback complete on eu-west-gpu-03 and 04 (535.54). kernel logfile after rollback shows no nvme timeouts. initial NG: p99 dropped to ~1.0s. waiting for full metrics.
kamal: customer notified, moved to eu-north, reports latency back to normal. :thumbsup: 
jordan: follow-ups: 1) bisect driver build to find regression patch 2) collect perf counters (nvme qdepth, tail latency histograms) 3) add automated canary checks for nvme tail post-driver upgrade 4) update runbook.
emma: created incident ticket INC-2026 and linked timeline + logs. tagging eng-runtime and eng-infra for root-cause. assigning to liam for bisect.
liam: I'll run bisection tomorrow, will capture perf counters using bpftrace and iostat. dumping current log pointers:
/var/log/kern.log
/var/log/redwood/serving/latency.log
santiago: thanks all — mitigation worked, keeping this open until bisect complete. :eyes:
